name: Fuzzy Previous Version Match Word Count Step
overview: Counts the words in text units whose top alternate translation is a `FUZZY_PREVIOUS_VERSION` match — a fuzzy (partial) match that, in addition, comes from the immediately preceding version of the same document. The match must originate in the version directly before the one being leveraged (for example, when leveraging v4 the match comes from v3, not v2 or v1). The count is recorded as a word-count metric in a `MetricsAnnotation` so that scoping and pricing steps can distinguish previous-version fuzzy leverage from ordinary fuzzy matches.
processingNotes: Operates per segment: it inspects the first (top-ranked) `AltTranslation` on each target segment's `AltTranslationsAnnotation` and counts a segment only when that match type is exactly `FUZZY_PREVIOUS_VERSION`.
Counting is performed on the **source** text, not the target — the word total reflects the source volume leveraged at this match level.
Words are counted with the GMX-V word counter; the parallel character-count variant counts characters instead.
Counts only translatable text units; empty text units and non-translatable ones are skipped.

Results are stored as annotations on filter events and aggregated to the configured levels (text unit, group, document, sub-document, batch item, batch); the step produces no output document of its own.

Belongs to the `OKAPI_WORD_COUNTS` category group. The `CategoryResolver` keeps only the highest-ranked matching category per segment — `FUZZY_PREVIOUS_VERSION` ranks above plain `FUZZY` but below `FUZZY_UNIQUE_ID` and all exact categories.
